editorial_standard: Sources guide the script; source material is not copied into narration. Resolve contested dates and research limitations before final publication.

chapters.title: Big Void
chapters.editorial_caution: Muon anomaly is established; function unknown.

chapters.title: Khufu and royal funerary complex
chapters.editorial_caution: Dates and construction years are estimates; main chambers and casing are documented.

chapters.title: Pre-Giza architecture
chapters.editorial_caution: Sequence Djoser, Sneferu, Khufu; avoid unsupported claims about specific design decisions.

chapters.title: Stone sourcing
chapters.editorial_caution: Tura casing stone shipped; local core and granite blocks require different methods.

chapters.title: Merer's papyri
chapters.editorial_caution: Ancient daily shipping notes are not a comprehensive pyramid blueprint.

chapters.title: Ahramat Nile branch
chapters.editorial_caution: Branch identification supported by field and remote-sensing evidence; each site and period require care.

chapters.title: Heit el-Ghurab workers settlement
chapters.editorial_caution: Settlements and food supply exist; workers' legal status was not uniform or wholly documented.

chapters.title: Interior layout
chapters.editorial_caution: Queen's Chamber is a conventional modern label, not proof a queen was entombed there.

chapters.title: North face corridor and robots
chapters.editorial_caution: Distinct from the 2017 Big Void. Robotics reference: https://robotics.leeds.ac.uk/case-studies/djedi-robot-archaeological-expedition/

chapters.title: Royal boats
chapters.editorial_caution: Two dismantled boats; exact ceremonial use under discussion.

chapters.title: Sphinx and surrounding complex
chapters.editorial_caution: Architectural sequence favours Fourth Dynasty Khafre attribution; early date theories need independent corroboration.

chapters.title: Retracted radar study
chapters.editorial_caution: Journal retracted paper in August 2026 citing methodological and statistical issues; authors disagreed.

chapters.title: Final synthesis
chapters.editorial_caution: Make clear the distinction between detected features, informed hypotheses, legends and unsupported claims.
